Treasure is a gaming project on the Arbitrum network that revolves around community management, with a focus on small gaming communities. Each project featured on the Treasure platform utilizes MAGIC within their respective Metaverses. Within the ecosystem, individual communities have the ability to trade NFTs and collaborate with each other using MAGIC tokens.

Treasure integrates DeFi, NFTs, and gaming as three distinct components. MAGIC serves as the digital currency used across various games. Treasures represent in-game NFT items, while Legions are NFT characters on the platform. MAGIC tokens enable the transformation of NFT Treasures into income-generating assets, while Legions assist in earning NFT Treasures and mining MAGIC tokens.

MAGIC is the native token of the Treasure ecosystem, unifying separate gaming communities from different Metaverses. The digital asset has been specifically designed to become increasingly scarce over time as more players join the ecosystem.
